source: Ranking and search row of the build-spec pattern table
description: Measures two result semantics the interface keeps apart: a Noul battery whose P(true) values are compared across candidates to order a shortlist, and a normalised Choice over tagged line or candidate ids paired with an independent Noul that says whether an answer is present at all. Headline metrics are top-1 accuracy and MRR from the rankings blocks, which are threshold free, plus accuracy at 0.5 on the standalone presence Nouls of the absent-answer cases. The per-candidate Noul targets inside ranking cases are ordinal evidence only: their absolute level is uncalibrated and they must not be pooled with the Choice distribution or scored as independent booleans. Every ranking case has exactly one passage that entails the answer on its own, so each expected_order is an unambiguous top-1 prefix and no scorer has to break a tie. This suite does not measure retrieval recall, generation, citation formatting, or probability calibration outside the absent-answer cases. The 30-candidate and 218-line fan-outs of the original workloads are sampled down to at most 16 lines and 5 candidates to respect the 26-option Choice cap, the 32-question request cap, and the 2048-token context.
